\chapter{My Ping}
\label{\detokenize{ping:module-my_ping}}\label{\detokenize{ping:my-ping}}\label{\detokenize{ping::doc}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!my\_ping@\spxentry{my\_ping}}\index{my\_ping@\spxentry{my\_ping}!module@\spxentry{module}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
A simple implementation of the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ping}} command (macOS\sphinxhyphen{}style output).

\sphinxAtStartPar
Sends ICMP Echo Requests over a raw socket and prints the replies.
Requires root/administrator privileges.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Example:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{sudo} \PYG{n}{python3} \PYG{n}{my\PYGZus{}ping}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{py} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{n}{c} \PYG{l+m+mi}{4} \PYG{n}{google}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{com}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\chapter{My Traceroute}
\label{\detokenize{traceroute:module-my_traceroute}}\label{\detokenize{traceroute:my-traceroute}}\label{\detokenize{traceroute::doc}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!my\_traceroute@\spxentry{my\_traceroute}}\index{my\_traceroute@\spxentry{my\_traceroute}!module@\spxentry{module}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
A simple implementation of the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{traceroute}} command (macOS\sphinxhyphen{}style output).

\sphinxAtStartPar
UDP probes are sent with an increasing TTL; routers along the path reply
with ICMP Time Exceeded and the destination replies with ICMP Port
Unreachable.  Requires root/administrator privileges.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Example:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{sudo} \PYG{n}{python3} \PYG{n}{my\PYGZus{}traceroute}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{py} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{n}{n} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{n}{q} \PYG{l+m+mi}{2} \PYG{n}{google}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{com}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}
